text: This report submits the Toronto Zoo 2025 Operating Plan and Budget for approval. The Policy & Finance Committee reviewed the 2025 Operating Plan and Budget on 2024-09-12 and recommended it for approval by the Board.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the 2025 Operating Plan and Budget as attached in Attachment 1 to the report (September 12, 2024) from the Director, Finance, Technology and Innovation, Toronto Zoo.
